Minnesnowii Shave Ice

How Minnesnowii was formed, we combined our love for Hawaii and Minnesota and created Minnesnowii Shave Ice. We serve Authentic Hawaiian Style Shave Ice just like in Hawaii. We use flavors imported from Hawaii and commercial block shavers to finely shave the ice so soft that there is never a crunch from the first bite till the last. It’s very light, fluffy, and flavorful! Don’t mistake shave ice with a sno-cone. There is a huge difference in texture. Please, feel free to follow us as we will be serving numerous county fairs and festivals this summer including the most notable: Minnesota State Fair: August 24th – September 4th across from the GIANT SLIDE!

About Minnesnowii

Minnesnowii was created by Me, Jason Giandalia.

I was on a trip to Oahu and a friend invited me to get some shave ice. Honestly, I was like “Bro, I didn’t come all the way to Hawaii for a snow cone.” He was like: “Trust me, it’s different!” I trusted him and I am glad I did! I waited over an hour in line for my first cup in 85-degree weather.

I know this will sound cliche, but it was love at first bite! I asked my friends if we have anything like this back home and they all said no.

I searched everywhere for that style of ice I had in Hawaii back home and was disappointed every single time. People were serving snow cones calling it shave ice. I got upset. At that point, I got passionate and obsessed about sharing a little piece of my Hawaiian experience with our community here in Minnesota.

Since then, I have made it my mission to bring the finest shave ice with the highest quality of ingredients all over our community here in Minnesota. I welcome you to join us at any fair or festival. In addition, I offer catering services for small and large gatherings.
